claims.text: The Sungai Liang Cracker in Brunei is an ethane-based steam cracker operated by Coral Bay Olefins.
The Sungai Liang Cracker is located in Sungai Liang, Brunei.
The Sungai Liang Cracker is listed as operating as of 2024.
The capacity of the Sungai Liang Cracker is not publicly confirmed.

gaps.subject: Ethane-based steam crackers under construction in Southeast Asia
gaps.detail: No ethane-based steam crackers under construction are listed in the evidence.

coverage_note: Evidence covers only one operating ethane-based steam cracker in Southeast Asia and confirms no units under construction. Capacity for the operating unit is not publicly confirmed.
